manifest.name: @dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle
manifest.description: Remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: pick a machine and directory; the workspace UI, terminal, and remote_* tools run on the host while ordinary tools stay local

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: ssh-workspace-mount
      name: '@dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle/mount'
      config:
        daemonDir: '~/.dsh-workspace'
        node: node
        install: true
        toolPresets:
          - id: ssh-workspace
            mode: both
          - id: ssh-workspace-auto
            mode: auto
    - id: api-ssh-workspace
      name: '@dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle/api'
    - id: ui-ssh-workspace
      name: '@dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle'

# Remote-workspace presets. The plugin list mirrors the installed standard
# preset so the remote aliases delegate to the same official tool definitions;
# the mount config maps each preset id to its local-tool policy (both vs auto).
- insert:
    - id: preset-ssh-workspace
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: ssh-workspace
        name: SSH Workspace
        description: 'Based on Standard mode, provides both local and remote tools. 基于标准模式，同时提供本地工具和远程工具。'
        order: 5
        plugins: &ssh-workspace-plugins
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true
          - id: tool-plugin-market
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
            disabled: true
    - id: preset-ssh-workspace-auto
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: ssh-workspace-auto
        name: "SSH Workspace (Auto)"
        description: 'Based on Standard mode, automatically uses remote or local tools depending on the workspace type. 基于标准模式，根据工作区类型自动选择远程工具或本地工具。'
        order: 6
        plugins: *ssh-workspace-plugins

readme.text:
[English](./README.en.md) | 简体中文

DeepSeek Harness 的远程工作区插件：在 Web UI 里先选机器（本机或 `~/.ssh/config` 中的主机），
再选目录。工作区文件浏览、终端面板/工具与 `remote_*` 在远端执行；模型侧的普通
`read`/`write`/`edit`/`bash`/`grep`/`glob` 始终在 harness 本机执行，默认 cwd 为 `/tmp`
（可用 `localCwd` 修改）。远程工作区必须选择启用了 `remote_*` 的 preset，否则对话会被禁止。

SSH 只是数据管道。远端常驻 `workspace daemon`，客户端断线不会中断远端命令；重连后按偏移
续取输出与终态，写操作经 opId 幂等门，不会重放副作用。

readme.section: 模型侧工具（按 preset 启用）
readme.text:
`remote_*` 别名默认**不注册**。安装 bundle 会向 profile 注入两个 agent preset：

- **SSH Workspace**（id `ssh-workspace`）：注册 `remote_read`、`remote_write`、`remote_edit`、
  `remote_read_image`（有附件能力时）、`remote_bash`、`remote_grep`、`remote_glob`，同时保留
  同名本地工具；本地工具在本机执行，只有 `remote_*` 在远端执行。
- **SSH Workspace (Auto)**（id `ssh-workspace-auto`）：根据工作区类型自动选择本地工具或远程工具——
  本地工作区使用本地工具；远程工作区隐藏本地 `read`/`write`/`edit`/`read_image`/`bash`/
  `grep`/`glob`，只向模型暴露 `remote_*`，并注入“本项目是远程项目”的系统提示词。若当前 Host 无法安装遮蔽，会安全降级为 `both`。

readme.section: 模型侧工具（按 preset 启用）
readme.text:
preset 在创建会话或切换 preset 时生效；普通本地会话和未选择这两个 preset 的会话都不会看到
`remote_*`。工具复用官方工具的参数、审批、输出渲染与超时。文件工具路径和 `remote_bash` 的
`workdir` 只接受当前远程工作区内的路径；相对路径按远程当前目录解析。

执行边界与 preset 无关：普通文件系统工具、`bash`、`grep`/`glob` 始终在本机执行，cwd 默认为
`/tmp`（`localCwd` 可覆盖）；`remote_*`、终端面板与 `terminal_*`、工作区文件 UI 始终在远端执行。
在远程工作区中，只有启用了 `remote_*` 的 preset 可以对话；Standard 等未启用的 preset 会被禁止
输入并显示提示。若会话已经开始、preset 已锁定，请新建会话并选择 SSH Workspace preset。

readme.section: 模型侧工具（按 preset 启用）
readme.text:
`remote_grep`/`remote_glob` 使用 daemon 归档内置的 ripgrep。若远端缺少对应架构的二进制，
调用会报 `remote host '<host>' has no bundled ripgrep; use remote_bash with grep/find or reinstall the daemon`。

| 位置 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 宿主 | Node ≥ 20；`dsh` 0.2.1-rc.5；可用的 OpenSSH 客户端；可读的 `~/.ssh/config` |
| 远端 | Linux x64/arm64；Node ≥ 20；POSIX `sh`；`tar`；OpenSSH 服务端 |
| 认证 | 密钥或 ssh-agent 等**非交互登录**；不支持交互式密码 |
| SSH | OpenSSH ≥ 8.2（客户端需支持 `ControlMaster` / `-O forward`） |
| 终端 | 归档内含 linux-x64 的 node-pty；其他平台/架构缺少 node-pty 时仅终端不可用，文件与命令正常 |
| 搜索 | 归档内含 linux-x64/arm64 的 ripgrep；缺失时 `remote_grep`/`remote_glob` 报错，`remote_bash` 仍可用 |

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ya-b/dsh-ssh-workspace
```

这条命令会：

1. 把 `@dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle` 安装进 `web` profile；
2. 把该 bundle 追加到 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`；
3. 按包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 装入 `ssh-workspace-mount`、`api-ssh-workspace`、
   `ui-ssh-workspace` 三行，并加载 `presets/ssh-workspace.patch.yml` 注册两个 agent preset。

仓库已提交构建产物 `lib/` 与 `dist/daemon.tar.gz`，所以 Git 安装**不需要**额外构建。

安装后重启实例生效。

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add 'link:/abs/path/to/dsh-ssh-workspace'
```

`link:` 安装直接使用 checkout 中的 `lib/` 和 `dist/`。修改源码后重新执行
`pnpm run build`，再重启实例；只改源码不重建不会生效。

机器列表来自本机 + `~/.ssh/config` 中所有具体的 `Host` 别名（递归跟随 `Include`；
通配符和取反规则会被跳过，因为它们不是具体机器）。普通 OpenSSH 配置全部有效：
`HostName`、`Port`、`User`、`IdentityFile`、`ProxyJump`、`ProxyCommand` 等。

```sshconfig

Host devbox
  HostName 192.0.2.10
  User root
  Port 22
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

Include ~/.ssh/config.d/*
```

要求 `ssh devbox true` 能在不询问密码的情况下成功（密钥、agent 或 ControlMaster）。
修改 `~/.ssh/config` 后刷新浏览器页面，主机列表会重新枚举。
yaml

- id: api-ssh-workspace
  config:
    hiddenHosts:
      - automation
      - ci-runner
```

| 项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `daemonDir` | `~/.dsh-workspace` | **远端** daemon 状态目录；`~` 由远端 shell 展开 |
| `node` | `node` | **远端** Node 可执行文件；非交互 SSH 的 PATH 常找不到 nvm 的 Node，建议写绝对路径，如 `/usr/local/bin/node` |
| `install` | `true` | 首次使用某主机时投递内置 daemon 归档；按 (host, daemonDir, 归档摘要) 去重，远端成功后写 `archive.digest`，后续连接跳过重复上传（慢速链路的首次投递可能需要数分钟） |
| `autoUpgrade` | `true` | 连接时若运行中的 daemon 加载的 bundle 与已安装的 `workspaced.js` 摘要不一致，且无子进程在跑，就自动重启它；忙则保留旧版，下次连接再试 |
| `daemonArchive` | 内置归档 | 覆盖 daemon 归档路径，主要用于开发调试 |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 安装、准入、打开等管理请求的超时 |
| `requestTimeoutRetries` | `5` | 管理超时后对可重放操作（读或带 opId 的写）的额外重试次数；调用方取消不重试 |
| `requestTimeoutRetryBaseMs` | `10000` | 超时重试的首次等待，逐次翻倍（10s → 20s → 40s …），上限 `2147483647` |
| `reconnectBaseMs` | `250` | SSH 链路重连的退避初始值 |
| `reconnectMaxMs` | `15000` | 重连退避上限 |
| `controlDir` | 临时目录 | 本地 SSH ControlMaster socket 目录；不填则使用 `/tmp/dsh-ws-*` |
| `statePath` | `${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/storages/ssh-workspaces.json` | 本地工作区归属侧映射路径 |
| `localCwd` | `/tmp` | 远程工作区中普通本机工具的默认 cwd，必须是绝对路径；终端面板和 `remote_*` 不受影响 |
| `toolPresets` | `[]` | 允许启用 `remote_*` 的 agent preset 列表，元素为 `{ id, mode: 'both' \| 'auto' }`；bundle 默认注入 `ssh-workspace`（both）和 `ssh-work

`api-ssh-workspace` 的可配置项：

| 项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | `20000` | 主机连通性预检的单次超时 |
| `hiddenHosts` | `[]` | 不显示在机器列表中的 SSH 别名 |
| `prefix` | `/ssh-workspace` | HTTP 路由前缀；浏览器半固定使用 `/ssh-workspace`，**不要修改** |

`ui-ssh-workspace` 没有配置项。

覆盖参数时，在 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中按相同 `id` 重述整行配置：

```yaml

- id: ssh-workspace-mount
  config:
    daemonDir: '~/.dsh-workspace'
    node: /usr/local/bin/node
    install: true
    requestTimeoutMs: 30000
    requestTimeoutRetries: 5
    requestTimeoutRetryBaseMs: 10000
    reconnectBaseMs: 250
    reconnectMaxMs: 15000
    localCwd: /tmp
    toolPresets:
      - id: ssh-workspace
        mode: both
      - id: ssh-workspace-auto
        mode: auto
```

同一 `id` 的 `config` 会整体替换 bundle 中的配置，未写的字段使用 schema 默认值，
建议把需要的项写全。若 profile 的 patch 文件还是空数组 `[]`，用条目替换它，而不是
直接追加到 `[]` 后面。

首次在某个 (主机, `daemonDir`) 上打开目录时，插件会通过 SSH 把归档解压到远端
`daemonDir`，并执行远端 Node 版本检查。之后：

- daemon 状态在远端 `~/.dsh-workspace`：`sock`、`pid`、`lock`、`running.digest`、
  `config.json`、`streams/`、`daemon.log`，以及按架构拆分的 `bin/rg-linux-<arch>`；
- `config.json` 的 `roots` 是允许作为工作区打开的目录白名单，由客户端在打开前写入，
  保留最近 64 条；
- daemon 已运行时不重复启动；客户端断线、心跳或租约变化都不会回收远端进程；
- daemon 启动时把自己的 bundle 摘要写进 `running.digest`；连接时若与已安装的
  `workspaced.js` 不一致，且它没有子进程在跑，bootstrap 会优雅重启它以运行新代码
  （`autoUpgrade: false` 可关闭）；旧版本 daemon 没有该文件，首次连接时同样会被升级；
- 远端 Node 缺失或过旧会在建连阶段报
  `remote workspace daemon preflight failed: <node> is not a usable Node >= 20`。

1. 打开 Web UI，侧边栏「添加工作区（＋）」→「添加工作区…」。
2. 在弹窗顶部的**主机**下拉中选择本机或某个 SSH 主机。
3. 选择目录（可「上级」回溯、开关隐藏文件），点「打开」。
4. 远端工作区默认命名为 `<目录名>@<主机别名>`；工作区文件浏览、终端和 `remote_*` 在远端执行，
   普通模型工具仍在本机 `localCwd` 下执行。
5. 远程工作区需在会话的 preset 选择器中选择 **SSH Workspace** 或 **SSH Workspace (Auto)**；
   后者会根据工作区类型自动选择本地工具或远程工具。其他 preset 会显示警告并禁止输入。

升级 bundle：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update @dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle

readme.section: 或重新安装并锁定提交
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/ya-b/dsh-ssh-workspace#<sha>'
```

重启 dsh 实例后新代码生效。远端已运行的 daemon 不会自动换代码；必要时杀掉远端 daemon
进程，让下一次使用重新投递并启动：
bash
ssh <host> 'kill "$(cat ~/.dsh-workspace/pid)" 2>/dev/null || true'
```

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle
```

readme.section: 或重新安装并锁定提交
readme.text:
卸载只移除依赖、bundle 选择和它带来的三行 patch，不会删除本地侧映射或远端
`~/.dsh-workspace`。需要彻底清理时，先停掉远端 daemon，再删除数据：
bash
rm -f "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/storages/ssh-workspaces.json"
ssh <host> 'kill "$(cat ~/.dsh-workspace/pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf ~/.dsh-workspace'
```

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 弹窗里没有远端主机 | 确认是具体 `Host` 别名而非通配符；刷新页面；检查 `~/.ssh/config` 与 `Include` |
| 预检显示 `needs-credentials` | `ssh <alias> true` 必须无需交互即可成功；配置密钥或启动 agent |
| 报 Node 版本/路径错误 | 把 `node` 配成远端绝对路径，例如 `/usr/local/bin/node`；确认 `node -v` ≥ 20 |
| 终端打不开，但文件和命令正常 | 归档只带 Linux x64/arm64 的 node-pty；远端是其他平台/架构时不匹配，文件与命令不受影响 |
| 安装后没有出现菜单 | `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 检查三行 patch；重启 dsh 实例 |
| 升级后行为仍旧 | 重启 dsh 实例；远端 daemon 也要重启才会加载新归档 |

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build        # → lib/{mount,api,index,client}.js + dist/daemon.tar.gz

node tests/api/machines.test.mjs

`lib/` 与 `dist/daemon.tar.gz` 是 Git 安装使用的已提交产物：改源码后必须重建并提交。
更细的构建、回滚与运维说明见 [`INSTALL.md`](./INSTALL.md)，实现计划和证据台账见
[`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) 与 [`PROGRESS.md`](./PROGRESS.md)。

A remote workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness: in the Web UI, first pick a machine (local or a host
from `~/.ssh/config`), then pick a directory. The workspace file browser, terminal panel/tools, and
`remote_*` tools run on the remote host; the model's ordinary `read`/`write`/`edit`/`bash`/`grep`/
`glob` tools always run on the harness machine with `localCwd` (`/tmp` by default) as their cwd.
A remote workspace requires a preset that enables `remote_*`; otherwise conversation is blocked.

SSH is only a data pipe. A long-running `workspace daemon` lives on the remote side, so a client
disconnect does not interrupt remote commands; after reconnecting, output and final state are
resumed by offset, and writes go through an opId idempotency gate so side effects are never replayed.

The `remote_*` aliases are **not registered by default**. Installing the bundle injects two agent
presets into the profile:

- **SSH Workspace** (id `ssh-workspace`): registers `remote_read`, `remote_write`, `remote_edit`,
  `remote_read_image` (when attachments are available), `remote_bash`, `remote_grep`, and
  `remote_glob` while keeping the local tools of the same name; the local tools stay on the harness
  machine and only `remote_*` runs on the host.
- **SSH Workspace (Auto)** (id `ssh-workspace-auto`): automatically selects local or remote tools
  based on the workspace type — local workspaces use the local tools; adopted remote workspaces hide
  the local `read`/`write`/`edit`/`read_image`/`bash`/`grep`/`glob` tools so only `remote_*` reaches
  the model, and inject the "this project is remote" system prompt. If hiding cannot be installed
  for the current host, it degrades safely to `both`.

Presets take effect when a session is created or its preset changes; ordinary local sessions and
sessions without one of these presets never see `remote_*`. These tools reuse the official
arguments, approvals, output rendering, and timeouts. File-tool paths and `remote_bash`'s `workdir`
must stay inside the current remote workspace; relative paths resolve from the current remote
directory.

The execution boundary is independent of the preset: ordinary file, `bash`, `grep`, and `glob`
tools always run on the harness machine with `/tmp` (`localCwd`) as their default cwd, while
`remote_*`, the terminal panel/`terminal_*`, and the workspace file UI always run on the host.
Inside a remote workspace, only presets that enable `remote_*` may converse; Standard and any other
unconfigured preset disable input and show a warning. If the session already started and its preset
is locked, create a new session with an SSH Workspace preset.

`remote_grep`/`remote_glob` use the ripgrep binary shipped in the daemon archive. If the host lacks
a binary for its architecture, the call fails with
`remote host '<host>' has no bundled ripgrep; use remote_bash with grep/find or reinstall the daemon`.

| Location | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Host | Node ≥ 20; `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.5; a working OpenSSH client; a readable `~/.ssh/config` |
| Remote | Linux x64/arm64; Node ≥ 20; POSIX `sh`; `tar`; an OpenSSH server |
| Authentication | **Non-interactive** login via key or ssh-agent; interactive password auth is not supported |
| SSH | OpenSSH ≥ 8.2 (the client must support `ControlMaster` / `-O forward`) |
| Terminal | The archive ships node-pty for linux-x64; on other platforms/architectures without node-pty only the terminal is unavailable, files and commands still work |
| Search | The archive ships ripgrep for linux-x64/arm64; without it `remote_grep`/`remote_glob` fail while `remote_bash` still works |

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ya-b/dsh-ssh-workspace
```

This command will:

1. install `@dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle` into the `web` profile;
2. append the bundle to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`;
3. load the three entries `ssh-workspace-mount`, `api-ssh-workspace`, and `ui-ssh-workspace`
   according to the package's `cordis.patch.yml`, plus `presets/ssh-workspace.patch.yml` for the
   two agent presets.

The repository already commits the build artifacts `lib/` and `dist/daemon.tar.gz`, so installing
from Git does **not** require an extra build.

Restart the instance after installation.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add 'link:/abs/path/to/dsh-ssh-workspace'
```

A `link:` install uses `lib/` and `dist/` directly from the checkout. After modifying source, run
`pnpm run build` again and restart the instance; changing source without rebuilding has no effect.

The machine list comes from the local machine plus every concrete `Host` alias in `~/.ssh/config`
(following `Include` recursively; wildcard and negation patterns are skipped because they are not
concrete machines). Standard OpenSSH configuration applies: `HostName`, `Port`, `User`,
`IdentityFile`, `ProxyJump`, `ProxyCommand`, and so on.

```sshconfig

Host devbox
  HostName 192.0.2.10
  User root
  Port 22
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

Include ~/.ssh/config.d/*
```

`ssh devbox true` must succeed without prompting for a password (key, agent, or ControlMaster).
After editing `~/.ssh/config`, refresh the browser page to re-enumerate the host list.
yaml

- id: api-ssh-workspace
  config:
    hiddenHosts:
      - automation
      - ci-runner
```

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `daemonDir` | `~/.dsh-workspace` | **Remote** daemon state directory; `~` is expanded by the remote shell |
| `node` | `node` | **Remote** Node executable; the PATH of a non-interactive SSH session often cannot find nvm's Node, so an absolute path such as `/usr/local/bin/node` is recommended |
| `install` | `true` | Deliver the built-in daemon archive the first time a host is used; deduplicated by (host, daemonDir, archive digest). A successful install writes `archive.digest` on the host so later connections skip the upload (the first delivery can take minutes on a slow link) |
| `autoUpgrade` | `true` | On connect, if the running daemon's loaded bundle differs from the installed `workspaced.js` digest and it has no child processes, restart it; a busy daemon is kept and retried on the next connection |
| `daemonArchive` | built-in archive | Override the daemon archive path, mainly for development and debugging |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Timeout for management requests such as install, admit, and open |
| `reconnectBaseMs` | `250` | Initial reconnect backoff |
| `reconnectMaxMs` | `15000` | Maximum reconnect backoff |

Options for `api-ssh-workspace`:

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | `20000` | Per-attempt timeout for the host connectivity precheck |
| `hiddenHosts` | `[]` | SSH aliases not shown in the machine list |
| `prefix` | `/ssh-workspace` | HTTP route prefix; the browser half hardcodes `/ssh-workspace`, **do not change** |

`ui-ssh-workspace` has no options.

To override options, restate the entire row with the same `id` in the profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml

- id: ssh-workspace-mount
  config:
    daemonDir: '~/.dsh-workspace'
    node: /usr/local/bin/node
    install: true
    requestTimeoutMs: 30000
    reconnectBaseMs: 250
    reconnectMaxMs: 15000
    localCwd: /tmp
    toolPresets:
      - id: ssh-workspace
        mode: both
      - id: ssh-workspace-auto
        mode: auto
```

The `config` for the same `id` replaces the bundle's config wholesale; unspecified fields use schema
defaults, so it is best to write all needed fields. If the profile's patch file is still an empty
array `[]`, replace it with the entry rather than appending after `[]`.

The first time a directory is opened on a given (host, `daemonDir`), the plugin extracts the
archive over SSH into the remote `daemonDir` and runs the remote Node version check. After that:

1. Open the Web UI and go to the sidebar "Add workspace (+)" → "Add workspace…".
2. In the **Host** dropdown at the top of the dialog, select local or an SSH host.
3. Choose a directory (use "Up" to navigate, toggle hidden files), then click "Open".
4. The remote workspace is named `<directory>@<host alias>` by default; the workspace file browser,
   terminal, and `remote_*` tools run on the remote host, while ordinary model tools run locally
   under `localCwd`.
5. Remote workspaces must use **SSH Workspace** or **SSH Workspace (Auto)** in the session's preset
   selector; Auto selects local or remote tools automatically based on the workspace type. Other
   presets show a warning and disable input.

Upgrade the bundle:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update @dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle

readme.section: or reinstall and pin a commit
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/ya-b/dsh-ssh-workspace#<sha>'
```

The new code takes effect after restarting the dsh instance. A daemon already running on the remote
side switches code automatically: the next connection re-delivers the archive, sees that the running
digest differs, and restarts the daemon if it has no child processes — a busy daemon is left alonebash
ssh <host> 'kill "$(cat ~/.dsh-workspace/pid)" 2>/dev/null || true'
```

Uninstall:

readme.section: or reinstall and pin a commit
readme.text:
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @dsh-ssh-workspace/bundle
```

Uninstall only removes the dependency, the bundle selection, and the three patch lines it
contributed; it does not delete the local side mapping or the remote `~/.dsh-workspace`. For a full
cleanup, stop the remote daemon first, then delete the data:bash
rm -f "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/storages/ssh-workspaces.json"
ssh <host> 'kill "$(cat ~/.dsh-workspace/pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf ~/.dsh-workspace'
```

| Symptom | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| No remote hosts in the picker | Make sure it is a concrete `Host` alias rather than a wildcard; refresh the page; check `~/.ssh/config` and `Include` |
| Precheck shows `needs-credentials` | `ssh <alias> true` must succeed non-interactively; configure a key or start an agent |
| Node version/path error | Set `node` to an absolute remote path, e.g. `/usr/local/bin/node`; verify `node -v` ≥ 20 |
| Terminal won't open, but files and commands work | The remote platform/architecture does not match the node-pty in the archive; files and commands are unaffected |
| Menu does not appear after installation | Run `dsh --profile web --dump-config` to check the three patch lines; restart the dsh instance |
| Behavior is still old after upgrading | Restart the dsh instance; the remote daemon must also be restarted to load the new archive |
